endorsements.name: Tommy Murphy
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-8567
endorsements.description: Kubernetes Secrets Store CSI Driver Vault Plugin prior to v0.0.6, Azure Plugin prior to v0.0.10, and GCP Plugin prior to v0.2.0 allow an attacker who can create specially-crafted SecretProviderClass objects to write to arbitrary file paths on the host filesystem, including /var/lib/kubelet/pods.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.9)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Tommy Murphy
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-8568
endorsements.description: Kubernetes Secrets Store CSI Driver versions v0.0.15 and v0.0.16 allow an attacker who can modify a SecretProviderClassPodStatus/Status resource the ability to write content to the host filesystem and sync file contents to Kubernetes Secrets. This includes paths under var/lib/kubelet/pods that contain other Kubernetes Secrets.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.8)
